summary: Pearson plc filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Annual General Meeting held on 1 May 2026. All 23 resolutions were approved by shareholders, including routine items such as receiving annual accounts, declaring a final dividend, electing and re-electing directors, approving remuneration policy and report, re-appointing auditors, authorizing share allotment and share buybacks, and other governance matters. The filing is a standard post-meeting report of a foreign private issuer. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist campaign is disclosed. The filing is purely a routine update on corporate governance and shareholder voting outcomes.
